0.msg: Greetings. I am Kona! It's great to see you, either again or for the very first time!

1.msg: As a proud member of the, let's see here, ah, the Leafre Expedition, I never forget a face or name!

2.msg: All members of the, shoot, what was it again? Right, the Leafre Expedition... All members work hard, have the eyes of a hawk, a heart of steel, and an impeccable #bmemory#k!

3.msg: What else was there? Oh yeah, the eyes of a hawk and a heart of steel!

5.msg: What?! I NEVER forget anything, not ever!

7.msg: *sniffle* Okay, you caught me. I have a terrible memory. My expedition leader is even forcing me to play a game every day to train my memory.

8.msg: I'll teach it to you, if you promise not to tell about my slip-up.\r\n#e#b<Memory>#n#k\r Players: 2\r Limit: Up to 10 times a day\r Required Level: Lv. 33+\r Victory Requirements: Find matching cards. The player to match the most cards wins.\r Reward: #i4001833# #t4001833#

no.0: H, there! Have we met? Your face looks kind of familiar... Maybe...

yes.0: Play against your friends, and see who has the best, oh shoot, what was it again?\r\n#b(Talk to Kona to join the wait list for Memory.)#k
